question: Where should a penalty taker aim?
answer: Placement barely matters: high 75%, low 72%, centre 76%; CIs overlap. Shootout kicks 66% vs 75% in play.
findings: Upper half of goal: 74.7% scored (CI 70.5%-78.4%, n=462); lower half 71.5% (n=685). Misses over the bar included.
Centre third: 75.9% (CI 67.2%-82.9%, n=112); chosen on 10% of kicks.
Kicking foot's natural side 73.1% (n=617) vs open side 71.4% (n=419).
method: Every penalty with an end location. Thirds of the goal mouth (posts at y 36 and 44), high = end height 1 m or more. Outcome = scored; Wilson 95% CIs. Keeper dive direction is not in the open data.
data: StatsBomb open data, 23 full seasons/tournaments (2015/16 EPL, Serie A, Ligue 1; men's WC/Euro/Copa/AFCON; ISL; women's leagues and tournaments), 1,148 penalties incl. 336 shootout kicks.
split_check: High vs low: men 76% vs 70%, women 73% vs 74%; edge not consistent. Shootout gap holds (CIs apart).
